title: Ankhorage Cloudflare R2 Infrastructure
summary: Provides a Cloudflare R2 object-storage service adapter for provider-neutral infrastructure composition.
purpose: Translate portable object-storage service intent into Cloudflare R2 control-plane operations.
responsibilities: Create and reconcile R2-backed object-storage infrastructure through Cloudflare's account API.
Map provider responses and failures into the common infrastructure service result boundary.
Allow an injected control plane for deterministic tests or another trusted execution environment.
boundaries: Does not define provider-neutral infrastructure contracts.
Does not implement application object upload, download, or asset metadata operations.
Does not manage unrelated Cloudflare services.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting Cloudflare R2 as an object-storage service.
Operators provisioning R2 resources through portable infrastructure intent.
useCases: Provision or reconcile an R2 object-storage service.
Inspect provider-neutral service state backed by Cloudflare R2.
Inject a deterministic R2 control plane for tests.

architecture.role: An infrastructure service adapter translating portable object-storage intent to the Cloudflare R2 API.
invariants: Cloudflare-specific behavior remains behind the control-plane adapter.
Public results conform to the provider-neutral service boundary.
Tests can replace the external API through explicit injection.

configuration: Cloudflare account API credentials are required for the default control plane.
limitations: Application data-plane object operations are outside this infrastructure adapter.
